intent: Eight individually authored judgement/action tasks preserve hypothetical advice, actual effects, limited evidence, daily habits and unfinished needs.
picturePurpose: An original park-walking scene illustrates walking on one occasion. A learner-set illustrative week teaches daily without treating the picture as attendance evidence, establishing family relationship by appearance, or equating daily with nonstop activity.

workshop.title: 排一周的习惯，再核对判断依据
workshop.instruction: 安排daily walking，分清建议、已发生的事和还需要做的事。

items.label: wise：先查潮汐的判断
items.prompt: 被称为明智的是哪一步？
items.material: It was wise to check the tide first.
items.reason: wise评价判断或做法是否明智。这里评价先查潮汐，first不能漏；它不说明检查方法、潮汐数值或后来的结果，更不保证永远不会出问题。

wordDecision.prompt: 被称为明智的是哪一步？

rows.text: The check guaranteed that nothing could ever go wrong.

options.text: The tide check guaranteed that nothing could ever go wrong.

options.text: Checking the tide first was a wise decision.

items.label: foolish：评价假设，不是已发生
items.prompt: would说明建议，还是已经有人忽视了警告？
items.material: It would be foolish to ignore the warning.
items.reason: would be foolish to do评价一种假设做法不明智。原句没有报告谁已经忽视警告，也没有写忽视后的结果。foolish在be后作形容词，不要直接用名词fool替换。
items.hint: 保留would，不把建议写成已发生。

wordDecision.prompt: would说明建议，还是已经有人忽视了警告？

recordSelection.title: 评价假设，不编已发生
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 忽视将是不明智的
rows.text: Ignoring the warning would be foolish.

rows.label: 已经忽视了警告
rows.text: Someone has already ignored the warning.

items.label: silly：笑话帮助放松
items.prompt: 找准起作用的事和演出前的时间。
items.material: A silly joke helped us relax before the show.
items.after: joke helped us relax before the show.
items.reason: silly在这里修饰joke，可以是傻乎乎、逗人发笑的意思，不一定是严厉批评。helped us relax说明笑话帮助大家放松；before the show限定时间，不是演出结束后。

wordDecision.prompt: 找准起作用的事和演出前的时间。

recordSelection.title: 笑话帮忙，时间在演出前
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 演出前帮助放松
rows.text: A silly joke helped the group relax before the show.

rows.label: 只在演出结束后
rows.text: The joke helped only after the show had ended.

items.label: lazy：累了不等于懒
items.prompt: 只因为累了，能给人贴lazy的标签吗？
items.material: Do not call someone lazy just because they are tired.
items.reason: call somebody lazy中的lazy说明给对方贴的标签。just because they are tired提醒我们：不能只因为累了就判断人家懒。它没有诊断疲劳原因，也不证明任何人永远不会懒。
items.hint: 不能只凭一个表现下判断，也别推出相反的绝对结论。

wordDecision.prompt: 只因为累了，能给人贴lazy的标签吗？

recordSelection.title: 疲劳本身不足以下标签
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.text: Tiredness alone does not justify calling someone lazy.

rows.label: 累的人一定懒
rows.text: Every tired person is necessarily lazy.

options.text: Every tired person is necessarily lazy.
options.reason: 把禁止的简单判断当成结论了。

options.text: The sentence proves that no tired person could ever be lazy.

options.text: Being tired alone is not a reason to label someone lazy.

items.label: active：把daily排进示意周
items.prompt: 点日期安排步行：daily只包括工作日吗？
items.material: My grandparents stay active by walking daily.
items.reason: active是形容词，activity是名词。stay active表示保持活力；by walking说明方式，daily表示每天。示意周由你安排，不是真实出勤记录；每天步行也不等于全天不停运动。图片只示意walking，亲属关系和习惯频率由原句说明。
items.hint: 把daily排成每天，再区分每天和全天。

wordDecision.prompt: 点日期安排步行：daily只包括工作日吗？

dailyWalk.title: 用示意周表示daily
dailyWalk.hint: daily是每天；示意周不代表真实出勤记录。
dailyWalk.wrong: 给示意周的每一天安排步行，再保留每天步行的习惯；不能补成全天不停活动。

items.label: serious：需要认真讨论，还没说已完成
items.prompt: 原句说需要讨论，还是讨论已经结束？
items.material: We need a serious discussion about safety.
items.reason: serious修饰discussion，表示认真的、严肃的。We need说明还需要这种讨论，不是已报告讨论完成。serious也可以形容病情严重，但这里的名词和safety把词义限定在讨论上。

wordDecision.prompt: 原句说需要讨论，还是讨论已经结束？

items.label: funny：画让全班笑了
items.material: The funny drawing made the whole class laugh.
items.after: drawing made the whole class laugh.
items.reason: funny修饰drawing，在这里表示好笑、逗人发笑。fun通常作名词，口语中也可作形容词，表示好玩、有趣；不要只因拼写相近就把两者当成同义词。made the whole class laugh中laugh用原形，不加to。原句报告全班笑了，不能改成只有某个人笑或靠外表推断感受。
items.hint: whole class不是only one；make后接动词原形。

items.label: gentle：这里要求动作轻柔
items.prompt: 原句在给操作建议，还是报告动作已完成？
items.material: Use a gentle touch when handling the chick.
items.reason: gentle在a gentle touch中作形容词，表示动作轻柔；gently是副词。Use给出指令，when handling说明何时这样做。原句没有报告谁已经拿过小鸡，也不说明处理后的结果。
items.hint: touch前用gentle；Use的指令不等于已完成。

wordDecision.prompt: 原句在给操作建议，还是报告动作已完成？

options.text: The instruction requests rough handling.

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the advice and unfinished plan accurate?
transfer.passage:
Getting ready for a class outing
My grandparents walk daily and offered to join our coastal outing. Before we fixed the route, I checked the tide. Our teacher called this a wise first step.
‘It would be foolish to ignore the warning,’ she added. Some classmates were tired after rehearsal. ‘Do not call them lazy just because they are tired,’ she reminded us.
We still need a serious discussion about the safe route before we choose our final plan. Tomorrow we will bring our ideas to class.

options.text: Ignoring the warning is discouraged; tiredness alone does not show laziness; the serious discussion is still needed.
The teacher reports that someone ignored the warning; tiredness alone does not show laziness; the serious discussion is still needed.
Ignoring the warning is discouraged; every tired classmate is necessarily lazy; the serious discussion is still needed.
Ignoring the warning is discouraged; tiredness alone does not show laziness; the serious discussion has already finished.

answer.display: Ignoring the warning is discouraged; tiredness alone does not show laziness; the serious discussion is still needed.

explanation.strategy: 先区分would的假设评价与实际发生，再核对判断lazy的依据，最后保留still need的未完成状态。

steps.text: 老师劝大家别忽视警告，没有报告谁已忽视；也不能只因疲劳就说同学懒。
steps.reason: would be和just because分别限制动作是否发生以及判断的依据。

steps.text: 认真讨论路线仍然是需要做的事，不是已经结束。
steps.reason: still need和before we choose our final plan说明计划尚未完成。

distractors.reason: 把假设评价改成已经有人忽视警告的报告。
把疲劳本身当成判断懒惰的充分依据。
把仍需讨论改成讨论已完成。

explanation.pitfall: 把建议写成已发生，把单一表现当成充分依据，把需要写成已完成。

segments.note: 单一表现不足以下标签
需要的讨论还没报告完成
